ValidationRule.description: BRME-5794: Validation rule to prevent private interactions from being submitted to CityView
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Interaction_Validation__c, OR( AND( ISNEW(), Add_to_CityView__c, Private_Interaction__c ), AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Add_to_CityView__c), ISCHANGED(Private_Interaction__c) ), Add_to_CityView__c, Private_Interaction__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot Save. Interactions cannot have both Private and Submit to CityView checkboxes checked.
